_about: Verdicts by Claude (one reader, not independently reviewed) for the 12 issues kept by one plain-prompt run on DVNA [clean variant: docs, in-app learn pages and vulnerability list removed], gemini-3.1-flash-lite, 2026-10-18. Read against the DVNA source.

core/appHandler.js:128.note: req.flash('danger', err) shows the database error object to the user: a mild information disclosure, real but low severity, and not the labelled calculator stack trace

core/appHandler.js:144.note: the mechanical scorer also credited useredit-idor because the evidence sits in the same function; the claim is about CSRF

core/appHandler.js:197.note: the mechanical scorer also credited stack-trace-calc; the claim is about arbitrary evaluation

core/appHandler.js:206.note: two titles on one issue: the admin pages rely on hiding content rather than a server-side check, and the users API returns every column

core/appHandler.js:235.note: mechanical scorer also credited no-csrf-protection, which this finding does not claim

server.js:24.note: also notes secure:false; the mechanical scorer credited no-csrf-protection, wrongly

views/app/products.ejs:50.note: titled 'reflected' but the cited lines are the product listing fields rendered unescaped, which is the stored form
